_source: The Design type's runtimes (artifact-type/dc-runtime.js) this toolkit's Chrome suite has passed on, by SHA-256. The translator lays a canvas out with the runtime the canvas serves, saved beside its artboards as support.js, and refuses one not listed here until the suite has passed on it (docs/claude-design.md, section 5). Add one with: python -m gdl.design pin-runtime <dc-runtime.js> --seen <where it came from>
